facts.value: ASU offers many safety services and resources to students including secure residence halls staffed around the clock, a full-time, full-service university police force, safety escorts, emergency call boxes located throughout all ASU campuses and parking garages that connect directly to the police department, an alert system to immediately contact students in the event of a campus emergency, and a safety smartphone app called LiveSafe.
